reviews.title: App Issues
reviews.text: The app has issues a lot with showing stats. When i click on stats, it closes out. This makes you have to delete the app and redownload it. When this is done you lose all of your information. This happens on a regular. I asked for my money back but never got a response.

reviews.title: Wrong
reviews.text: I was awake from 12:30 am to about 3 and this app said i was sleeping. I know i have sleep apenea and snore and toss app dais i did none lol i have another app that tells me all of this. This was a waste of my money :-(

reviews.title: I did not sign up for this and I’m being charged and I can’t get out of the charge on my account!
Confusing
reviews.text: The tracking is good but I do NOT want to wake up to any preset music, sounds or poems, just peace and quiet. It should be an easier way to just turn everything off! I do not need or want any noise to sleep nor do I want noise when I wake up. I write this long review because I just slept at least close to my goal but these noises set me in a bad enough mood to discontinue. I had a previous App that made it very easy to turn off any noise and only collect sleep data.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: What is your priority? The application process did not let me complete it after I entered my email. The button did not function. I don’t know what else to do. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: App does not work
reviews.text: Breaks sleep up on 12 screens. Not a clean snapshot

reviews.title: Didn’t Start

reviews.title: Worst Update Ever
reviews.text: Every time I check in my analysis of sleep patterns, the app shuts down and closes me out! I’m counting on this app to help me so I can report my  sleep patterns to my doctor and for my clinical trial! Please fix this STAT.

reviews.title: NOT FREE ( lie ) !!!!
reviews.text: Straight Lie on saying it’s free BECAUSE IT MOST CERTAINLY IS NOT FREE ! Click bait is what it is !

reviews.title: BEST TRACKER
reviews.text: I absolutely love this app!!! From the sleep sounds to the recorder. This app helped me sleep so much better and have better sleeping habits.

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: Love this app for tracking my sleep!

reviews.title: Best sleep ever
reviews.text: As a person with lots of anxiety and have hard time sleeping at night I found this one of the best apps to help me fall asleep , it’s not just rain sounds and your done no it tracks sleep patterns and also lets you create your own sounds and also asmr there’s not many apps that have an all in one bundle like this one also helps clear your mind for studying

reviews.title: Can’t filter out white noise
reviews.text: I run a fan at night and so it said I didn’t sleep at all even though I did.

reviews.title: Trial scam.
reviews.text: Huge ad when downloaded saying try 3 free days then be charged at end of trial. Nope. Was immediately charged $68 for the full year. No response from customer support yet. Terrible reputation off the start.
